name: Long Time No Life
source:
After a lifetime of research, the Resurrection Project BEARS FRUIT!  

You're ALIVE once again... with some caveats.

[From [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/long-time-no-life]Itch.io[/url]]

經過一輩子的研究，「復活計畫」終於結出碩果！

你又一次活了過來……不過有些條件限制。

[來源：[url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/long-time-no-life]Itch.io[/url]]
